violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: commercially made, serving size chicken wing dressings: b;use cheese=44F, Ranch dressing=44F, Yum Youming dressing=44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All discarded, during the inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor under the cooking equipment under the hood system, is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Frequently clean under the grill, fryers, stove, and other cooking equipment to prevent debris accumulations.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device/FOOD THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Paste, sauces, spices in unmarked containers and unmarked squeeze bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIUM COMPOUND (QAC) test kit TO MONITOR THE CONCENTRATION OF THE SANITIZING IN THE SOLUTION

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The (faucet/fixture) at the 3-compartment sink faucet is functioning improperly because the component is damaged, not providing sufficient water, or condition is in poor repair.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair this sink properly to ensure sufficient water is being provided for proper washing, rinsing, and sanitizing of utensils and equipment.
